info.title: StockFlow API
info.description:
StockFlow provides authentication, master data, inventory balances, append-only stock movement history, and order management. Authentication uses JWT Bearer access tokens. Public user registration always creates the SALES_STAFF role.

All resource IDs are PostgreSQL BIGINT values serialized as strings. List endpoints use offset pagination (limit defaults to 50, maximum 100; offset defaults to 0).

Checks PostgreSQL with a lightweight SELECT 1 query. Returns 503 when the database check fails.

post.description: Public registration always assigns the SALES_STAFF role; clients cannot select a role. Rate limit: 5 requests per IP per hour.
Authenticates credentials and returns a signed JWT access token. Rate limit: 10 requests per IP per 15 minutes.

get.description:
Returns active warehouses using offset pagination.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF, SALES_STAFF.

post.description:
Increases the on-hand balance and appends a RECEIPT stock movement in the same transaction.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF.

Decreases the on-hand balance and appends an ISSUE stock movement in the same transaction. The request quantity is positive.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF.

Applies a non-zero signed quantityDelta and appends an ADJUSTMENT stock movement in the same transaction.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF.

patch.description:
Changes the reorder threshold without changing physical on-hand quantity.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF.

get.description:
Returns append-only stock movement history with optional filters and offset pagination.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF.

SALES_STAFF users only receive orders they created; ADMIN and WAREHOUSE_STAFF can list all orders.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF, SALES_STAFF.

post.description:
Creates a DRAFT order. Unit prices are taken from the current product records; clients cannot submit prices.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, SALES_STAFF.

get.description:
A SALES_STAFF user can only retrieve their own orders; other users' orders are concealed as not found.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF, SALES_STAFF.

patch.description:
Only DRAFT orders can be updated. ADMIN can update any draft; SALES_STAFF can update only drafts they created.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, SALES_STAFF.

post.description:
Confirms a DRAFT order, verifies available stock, deducts inventory atomically, and appends ORDER_CONFIRM movements.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF.

A SALES_STAFF user may cancel their own DRAFT order. Cancelling a CONFIRMED order is restricted to ADMIN and WAREHOUSE_STAFF and restores stock atomically.

**Allowed roles:** ADMIN, WAREHOUSE_STAFF, SALES_STAFF.
